source: Authored synthetic business stories, not observed customer cases

cases.story: An administrator creates five teams without silently gaining their private reviews.
Return exact Decimal settlement amounts in customer JSON reports; preserve cents and never recapture a payment. The unsupported change must become a saved engineering work item, not an access grant.
Deduplicate a partner delivery retry after a provider timeout without sending the same security alert twice. The unsupported change must become a saved engineering work item, not an access grant.

Preserve leading whitespace in native credit-note templates so a customer reconciliation retains its indentation. The unsupported change must become a saved engineering work item, not an access grant.

Merge duplicate company contacts while preserving the audit trail and excluding contacts owned by another customer. The unsupported change must become a saved engineering work item, not an access grant.
Export a PDF renewal summary while preserving the negotiated approval threshold and discount history. The unsupported change must become a saved engineering work item, not an access grant.
Payments engineers and their manager inspect their work; a different team cannot read or take it over.
Notifications engineers and their manager inspect their work; a different team cannot read or take it over.
Billing engineers and their manager inspect their work; a different team cannot read or take it over.
CRM engineers and their manager inspect their work; a different team cannot read or take it over.
Deals engineers and their manager inspect their work; a different team cannot read or take it over.
An external auditor reads settlement evidence, then loses access on revoke.
A delivery investigator receives read-only incident evidence without access to billing.
A temporary reconciliation reviewer previews exact invoice-brief access before approval.
A migration contractor receives customer-brief access without changing ownership.
A renewal reviewer reads the deal brief without approving or editing the deal.
A Payments lead also manages Billing, sees the exact union, and remains unable to change either review.
A Payments author transfers to CRM; the saved settlement review stays with Payments colleagues.
An enabled engineer with no team gets an empty workspace and cannot borrow a project identifier.
An invitation enrolls a new manager in Billing only; the one-time token cannot create a second account.
A notification manager audits only notification events, evidence and request progress.
A Deals manager sees its PDF demand count and real grant reads; other teams do not inflate its counts.
A CRM manager inspects every assurance section without receiving another team request or code item.
A Billing engineer guessed a Payments URL; both current policy preview and actual protected read deny it.
A caller attempts to overwrite the server-derived team using an extra body field and a foreign project.
Identical team names in two organizations cannot confer access; normalized duplicates conflict locally.
Payments runs a pinned published software case in actual baseline/candidate containers and saves an exact reviewed patch, without deployment.
Billing runs a pinned published software case in actual baseline/candidate containers and saves an exact reviewed patch, without deployment.
An unsupported notification retry change stays inspectable and can be taken over by a teammate while the model is unavailable.
An administrator can inspect membership revisions without implicitly changing existing approved grants or hiding historical review authors.
